name: @organza/shared
description: Organza Store — shared TypeScript types + Zod schemas, consumed by backend/admin/pos (and later frontend) as a workspace dependency.
_comment_exports: Subpath map for the way the apps actually import this package: the four barrels by name (@organza/shared/types), and any single module underneath them through the wildcard (@organza/shared/types/product -> dist/types/product.js). The explicit barrel keys have to come before './*' because that wildcard would otherwise resolve './types' to dist/types.js, which does not exist — Node prefers the most specific match, and these are it.
_comment_typesVersions: The same map again, for TypeScript's node10 resolver. admin and pos are on moduleResolution 'bundler' and read `exports` directly, but the backend is a CommonJS Node service on moduleResolution 'node', which ignores `exports` entirely — without this it resolves @organza/shared/types/product to the package root and reports TS2307. Node itself still resolves the real thing at runtime through `exports` above; this only teaches tsc where the declarations are. Keep the two lists in step.
_comment_prepare: `prepare` is what replaced the old scripts/build-shared.js in each app. npm runs it for a workspace package on every `npm install` and `npm ci` at the root — including a scoped `npm ci -w admin`, because shared is a linked dependency of admin — so dist/ exists before anything tries to compile against it, with no copy step and no symlink to hand-manage. It goes through scripts/prepare.js rather than straight to `npm run build` because npm runs it for production installs too, where this package is only its `files` list (dist/, no src/, no TypeScript) and there is nothing to compile — see that script.
